{{Quote|There's Dennogra, home of Sprool the Trader. Plot a course for Zio Snaffkin Spaceport, Chewie.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="The Rebel Thief">{{StoryCite|series=Star Wars Kids (1997)|srtext=''Star Wars Kids'' (1997)|issue1=1|issue2=5|story=The Rebel Thief}}</ref>}}
'''Dennogra''', formerly known as '''Tialvai''', was an arid [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. One of its [[City/Legends|cities]], [[Zio Snaffkin]], was the home of [[Sprool]] the Trader.

==History==
Tialvai was a member of [[Xim's empire]], before its collapse in [[25,100 BBY]]. It was a member world of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and [[Jedi Civil War]].

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] hired [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] to dig for artifacts on Dennogra. The Jawas, however, were secretly interested in selling their findings.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Jawa Antiquities}}</ref>

The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] had relinquished their claim to the planet by [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]]. At some point, [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] killed a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sider]] on the world.<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Dennogra was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] took two crates of treasure to [[Zio Snaffkin]], where they were sold to [[Sprool]] the Trader.
